summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CraftBolt iteration 5 - Clickable Profile Links & Punctuality Score System. All 10 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified: clickable customer/supplier profile links in DemandDetail sidebar, profile page renders correctly for other users, punctuality score badge displays on supplier profiles.
critical_code_review_comments: DemandDetail.jsx correctly implements <Link> wrappers with data-testid='customer-profile-link' and data-testid='supplier-profile-link'
ProfilePage.jsx correctly displays punctuality_score badge with data-testid='punctuality-score-badge' when score exists
App.js route /profil/:id correctly renders ProfilePage for viewing other users' profiles
Backend demands.py calc_punctuality function correctly calculates scores: <=30min=100%, 30-60min=90%, 60-120min=70%, 120-240min=50%, >240min=30%
Backend reviews.py correctly blends punctuality into rating_percentage: final_pct = (review_avg * 0.8) + (punctuality * 0.2)
UserResponse model includes punctuality_score and avg_arrival_minutes fields
helpers.py user_to_response correctly maps punctuality fields
seed_data_creation: Created test suppliers and customers during backend testing for punctuality and review blending tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 features verified: 1) Clickable customer profile link in DemandDetail sidebar navigates to /profil/{customer_id}, 2) Clickable supplier profile link in DemandDetail sidebar navigates to /profil/{assigned_supplier_id}, 3) Profile page at /profil/:id renders correctly for viewing other users (read-only mode), 4) GET /api/users/{id} returns punctuality_score and avg_arrival_minutes fields, 5) POST /api/demands/{id}/arrive calculates punctuality_score based on arrival time and stores it on supplier user, 6) POST /api/reviews creates review and blends punctuality into rating_percentage (80% reviews + 20% punctuality), 7) Punctuality badge with data-testid='punctuality-score-badge' shows on supplier profile when punctuality_score exists, displaying 'X% dochvilnost'.
